title: local_heal_receipt_v1
description: Unified receipt schema for local_heal pipeline execution results

task_id.description: Unique task identifier (instance_id). Primary key for dedup.

simulated.description: True if this result was generated by simulate_task() or MagicMock, not real execution.

claim_eligible.description: True if this result can be used in public benchmark claims. Requires: simulated=false, real model execution, receipt present.

expected_stop_layer.description: The layer where the pipeline is expected to stop for this task type.

observed_stop_layer.description: The layer where the pipeline actually stopped.

failure_reason.description: Structured failure code. Empty string if solved. Examples: REPRO_NOT_REPRODUCED, SEARCH_MISMATCH, MODEL_TIMEOUT, VERIFIER_REJECTION.

model_calls.description: Number of LLM API calls made during pipeline execution.

visible_passed.description: True if visible tests passed after patch application.

hidden_passed.description: True if hidden verifier tests passed after patch application.

evidence_refs.description: List of evidence file paths (receipt, patch, logs, etc.).

wall_time_sec.description: Total wall-clock execution time in seconds.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this receipt was generated.

project.description: Source project (astropy, sympy, psf, django, etc.).

model_name.description: Name of the model used for patch generation (e.g., qwen2.5-coder:14b-instruct-q3_K_M).

model_phase_split.description: Which model was used for which phase (e.g., search=7b/patch=14b).

patch_path.description: Path to the generated patch file, if any.

solve_eligible.description: DEPRECATED: Use visible_passed AND hidden_passed instead. Kept for backward compatibility.
